title: Huly hero
description: Near-black hero with a huge white-to-lavender headline, a glowing ember pill, and a vertical blue-violet light beam that lands on a product window and flares along its top edge. A line of product areas sits underneath and scrolls as a marquee on phones.
notes: dark by default (tone="dark" adds the dark class); the beam reads best on a dark backdrop
the beam, flare and marquee are CSS animations, off under reduced motion; no JavaScript
leaves room at the top for a floating header (huly-header with position="absolute")
name: huly-hero

props.name: title
props.description: the page title; pass a list to choose the line breaks on wide screens

props.name: text
props.description: one or two sentences under the title

props.name: preview
props.description: what the light beam lands on: usually a product window (huly-window)

props.name: strip
props.description: the line under the preview: a label and a list of product areas (a marquee on phones)

props.name: tone
props.description: dark forces the dark colours (as on the original); inherit follows the page
